body:
I am currently high on Kratom
. I should note I'm coming down from a HB Woodrose trip (LSA) of 8 seeds.  The legal high extravaganza.
LSA is crazy shit.  I've done a fair amount of shrooms and I'd have to say the woodrose seeds might be stronger.  The most shrooms I've ever eaten in a sitting though is an eighth of an ounce so maybe I need to try more.  Anywho I digress.
Kratom.  Yeah....I feel nice.  Sinking into my chair and listening to music.  I feel like I just got into God's hot tub but I haven't been in so long that it has become uncomfortable.
I can't believe this shit is legal.  I think I could actually become addicted to this stuff.  It's that good.  I haven't been this impressed with a pleasure drug since ecstasy (not as good as x though).
It's good.  I took a Dramamine with it because I had some from the woodrose seeds and plus I heard Kratom can make you queasy.
Have fun.  Be safe.  Love the world and it will love you.
